title: DAGGER: Deployment-Free Quality Estimation for Generative AI Workflows
abstract: arXiv:2611.31252v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Estimating the quality of generative AI workflows is challenging because these workflows comprise multiple stages, and errors can propagate across them, making end-to-end performance depend not only on the accuracy of individual models but also on how their outputs affect downstream stages. Each stage can use one of many candidate models. Estimating end-to-end workflow quality by deploying and evaluating every resulting model configuration is therefore prohibitively expensive. As a result, existing approaches face a tradeoff between estimation cost and accuracy: inexpensive methods often produce unreliable quality estimates, while accurate methods require deploying and evaluating many workflow configurations. In this paper, we introduce DAGGER, a framework for estimating the quality of generative AI workflows without exhaustive deployment and profiling. translated_title: DAGGER：面向生成式AI工作流的无部署质量评估
translated_abstract: 估算生成式AI工作流的质量极具挑战性，因为这些工作流由多个阶段组成，错误可能在各阶段之间传播，使得端到端性能不仅取决于单个模型的准确性，还取决于各模型的输出对下游阶段的影响。每个阶段都可以从多个候选模型中选择一个。若要通过部署并评估所有可能的模型组合来估算端到端工作流质量，其成本将高得令人望而却步。因此，现有方法面临估算成本与准确性之间的权衡：低成本的方法往往产生不可靠的质量估算，而准确的方法则需要部署和评估大量的工作流配置。本文提出DAGGER，一个无需穷举部署和性能分析即可估算生成式AI工作流质量的框架。DAGGER将工作流表示为一个图，其中节点对应于各个阶段，边……
tldr: DAGGER框架通过将生成式AI工作流建模为图结构，实现了无需穷举部署与性能分析即可高效准确地估算工作流端到端质量，突破了现有方法在估算成本与准确性之间的权衡。
en_tdlr: DAGGER is a framework that models generative AI workflows as graphs, enabling efficient and accurate end-to-end quality estimation without exhaustive deployment and profiling, thus overcoming the cost-accuracy tradeoff of existing approaches.
